prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, choose_path layout, finish copy, finish new_screen, finish notification, home new_flow, sign_in hint, sign_in incentive, and sign_in layout because each has only 1 test.
Interactive finish flows (finish new_flow) were consistently helpful, winning across 2 tests.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path reorder and home notification changes across 2 tests each.
Home wait_info changes were helpful in 1 test (+4.2%), while 4 other tests showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign (3 tests), choose_path copy (3 tests), adoption hint (2 tests), sign_in notification (2 tests), and sign_in reorder (2 tests) hurt performance or showed no clear effect.

Changes:
0: [finish, new_flow] Companion Mood and Voice Sound Test Flow: Adds an interactive voice and sound test sub-flow screen right after home intro, allowing users to play sample pet audio reactions before finishing onboarding. (why: Interactive finish flows were proven winners (+). Support receives complaints after onboarding about how to talk to and interact with the desktop pet.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Hide and Seek Practice Screen: Inserts a practice screen demonstrating how to reveal, minimize, and recall the desktop pet before landing on the final desktop view. (why: Support mail highlights post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or find the pet on the desktop, while finish drop-off remains 15.8%.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Progress and Audio Status Wait Info: Replaces the waiting screen layout with step-by-step indicators showing pet sound synthesis and desktop rendering progress. (why: Home conversion drops to 87.9% with a median wait time of 201s. Earlier data showed home wait_info updates generated positive lift (+4.2%).)
3: [sign_in, copy] Multi-Device Pet Sync Sign-In Headline: Updates the sign-in headline and body text to emphasize automatic pet data synchronization across devices and reinstalls. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing back in. Clarifying sync upfront sets correct expectations.)
4: [finish, redesign] Spotlight Companion Command Training Hub Redesign: Redesigns home_intro into a spotlight layout with interactive action buttons to sample desktop pet interactions. (why: Finish screen drop-off is 15.8% and support users report post-onboarding control confusion. A spotlight interactive setup reinforces value.)
5: [home, new_flow] Companion Idle Animation Customizer Wait Flow: Adds an interactive idle animation selector component to the waiting screen while pet generation processes in the background. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s. Giving users an engaging idle customization activity keeps them active during generation.)
